title: BI & Data-Stack Cost and Capacity Trend
dataSources: Aggregated cat-24 indexes (BI usage, refresh/pipeline outcomes, data-quality incidents, cost/capacity metrics) summarised via `tstats`, `stats`, and summary indexing for adoption, SLA, and spend trends.
app: Cross-platform rollups over the indexes populated by the other cat-24 subcategories; Splunk ITSI (Splunkbase 1841) for service-level trending where available.
spl:
index=bi (sourcetype=powerbi:capacity:metrics OR sourcetype=aws:cloudwatch OR sourcetype=tableau:tsm:metrics)
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as avg_utilization by capacityName, _time
| where isnotnull(capacityName)
| sort _time
description: Trends capacity utilisation and cost signals across BI and data-stack platforms so FinOps can forecast spend and right-size Premium capacities, SPICE, and warehouse credits.
value: BI and data-stack costs are rising fast; a unified capacity trend enables forecasting and right-sizing instead of reactive, expensive upgrades.
implementation: Summary-index capacity/cost metrics across platforms; schedule daily; chart trends and forecast with predict where useful.
visualization: Multi-series timechart of utilisation/cost, forecast overlay.

references.title: Splunk — Use summary indexing for increased search efficiency

grandmaExplanation: We track what your analytics platforms cost and how full they are over time, so spending is planned instead of a surprise.
